data.text:
Please don’t use a motorcycle.

It’s high risk and no one thinks anything will happen to them until it does.

My grandfather died relatively young because of a motorcycle accident. He was hit by a bus. Everyone pleaded with him not to get it but he said it was cheaper. (He was a pastor in the Philippines and needed cheap, reliable transportation)

He drove carefully all the time but couldn’t control the actions of the bus driver.

His funeral is still one of the biggest funerals I’ve been to and he passed when I was a small child. 

He was loved by many in the Philippines and was taken too soon. He still had work to do.

Motorcycles aren’t worth it for any reason.

data.text:
According to officials, one of the fiercest typhoons of the year tore across the central Philippines, killing at least 40 people and forcing hundreds of thousands to evacuate their homes.

The majority of the deaths were caused by Typhoon Kalmaegi's flooding of the most populous central island of Cebu, which included entire towns.

The Philippine Air Force (PAF) reported that six crew members were killed when a military helicopter used to support relief efforts crashed on northern Mindanao island.

The number of casualties is expected to rise.
